mapper.select: SELECT slug, title, type, is_official, starts_at, ends_at, summary, location_name, ST_Y(location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(location::geometry) AS longitude, source_org, source_url, updated_at, COALESCE(ends_at < #{now}, false) AS ended FROM notice WHERE slug = #{slug} AND status = 'public'
mapper.sql:
FROM notice WHERE status = 'public' AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at >= #{now})
AND type = #{type}
